data.one_liner: Flutter plugin providing native AVPlayer and AirPlay route picker widgets for iOS and macOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget to play videos from a URL, local file path, or project asset using the native AVPlayer on iOS and macOS. Also provides a second widget to render the native AirPlay route picker for streaming content to available Apple devices.
use_when: You need to play local or network videos inside a Flutter app on iOS and macOS using native platform players.
You need to let users stream or mirror video content via AirPlay to compatible Apple devices.
You want to customize the tint color and appearance of the native AirPlay route picker view.
avoid_when: You need complex video player capabilities like full custom UI overlays, DRM protection, or subtitles beyond what native AVPlayer wrappers offer.
You are targeting platforms other than iOS and macOS (such as Android, Windows, or Linux).
strengths: Supports both iOS and macOS via native AVPlayer and AVRoutePickerView implementations.
Allows custom HTTP headers for network video streams (e.g., for Authorization tokens).
Provides both a standalone video player and a separate AirPlay route picker or icon button.
weaknesses: Limited to iOS and macOS platforms only.
Does not currently support streaming video from video sources like YouTube.
Relies on native platform views which may have integration limitations.
data.setup_notes: Requires iOS and macOS platform integration. No complex build_runner configuration required.
